POCKET GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set (CK33-60)

The POCKET GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | CK33-60 is a thoughtfully curated sustainable gifting solution designed for corporate events, employee onboarding, brand promotions, conferences, and eco-friendly celebrations. Compact, stylish, and environment-friendly, this set delivers high perceived value in a minimalistic 3″ x 7″ x 1″ pocket black box, making it a smart choice for brands looking to adopt greener gifting practices.

This eco gift set contains a Plantable Calendar (MDF) | 3.5″ x 5″, a Premium Plantable Pen, and Cork Sticky Notes — all crafted from sustainable materials. This makes the POCKET GIFT BOX ideal for companies searching for meaningful, modern, and eco-friendly corporate gifts.

Why Choose the POCKET GIFT BOX – Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

As more organizations shift towards green initiatives, the demand for eco-friendly corporate gifts is growing. The POCKET GIFT BOX – A Eco-Friendly Gift Set | CK33-60 meets this demand with high-quality, functional, and sustainable stationery items. From its plantable products to its compact recyclable packaging, every element in this gift box carries environmental value while ensuring practical usefulness for employees and clients.

What’s Inside the Gift Box?

  • Plantable Calendar (MDF | 3.5″x5″) – A unique calendar made with plantable seed paper sheets mounted on a durable MDF stand. Once the month is over, the sheets can be planted to grow herbs or flowers, promoting a zero-waste lifestyle.

  • Cork Sticky Notes – Natural cork-backed sticky notes that reduce plastic waste and offer an earthy, elegant look on any desk.
  • Pocket Black Box (3″x7″x1″) – A sleek, minimalist, and recyclable box, perfect for corporate branding and premium gifting.
